summary: McEwen Inc. filed an 8-K/A to correct a prior disclosure that a $49.4M dividend was received directly from its 49.0%-owned investee, Minera Santa Cruz S.A. (MSC), not indirectly. The dividend was generated by the San José silver-gold mine in Argentina, increasing total 2026 dividends from MSC to $58.2M. This is a routine reporting of an ordinary cash distribution from an equity investee, not a special situation like a capital return or strategic event. No deal terms, shareholder action, or structural change is involved.
